gate: B — style already approved (massar-design-language.md / _مسار/مسار.dc.html); variants explore layout within it
why_chosen: Only variant where the boundary is BOTH visible and persistent: the sticky navy scope banner states the window in words and travels with the operator down the page, so no scoped number is ever read without its scope in view.

The founder's literal question is comparative ('which one relates to the last one'). V3 is the only layout that puts all four per-recipient timestamps for every journey side by side in one scan. V1 hides them behind a tab switch; V2 hides them behind an accordion.
V2 has no page-level scope, so the lifetime blocks below it stay unscoped with nothing declaring the current scope — it solves the journey list but not the mixed-scope complaint.

rejected.v1-scope-strip: Tab strip is a filter, not a ledger — you cannot compare two journeys without losing the first. Mailchimp's date-filter failure mode.
rejected.v2-journey-cards: Strong per-journey isolation and the best empty/unattributed copy, but no global scope declaration; three stacked cards also push فهم المساعد far below the fold at 375.

remix_notes: Take V2's unattributed-row copy and its ٤-step wording verbatim into the V3 ledger.
Take V1's banner label «الأرقام في هذه الصفحة تخصّ» — more explicit than V3's original.
At 375 reduce ledger side padding 20px → 14px and let the scope <select> go full-width (width:100%) below the label block.

taste_preflight.design_read: An operator's magnifying glass: the page must say out loud which send it is currently reporting on, and refuse to show a number it cannot prove belongs there.
taste_preflight.design_system: none — bespoke (Massar design language, derived from _مسار/مسار.dc.html)
taste_preflight.taste_skill_exclusion_reason: Dashboard + data-table surface. TasteSkill v2's own scope excludes these; its marketing-layout and cinematic-motion recipes must not be imported. Only its brief-inference, accessibility floor, dark-mode-neutral, and anti-slop preflight discipline are applied.
checklist_notes: No em-dashes in shipped Arabic UI copy (Arabic uses — only inside campaign display names supplied by the operator).
Focus-visible ring on every interactive element (tabs, rows, select): 2px #2E7D77.
No motion beyond a 140ms hover tint; nothing animates on load.
No purple/indigo gradient, no glassmorphism, no emoji, no generic 'Insights' card.
Colour is never the sole carrier: every state chip pairs a tinted dot with an Arabic word.
